plugins.name: ciwg-knowledge
plugins.description: Company knowledge auto-injection: relevant call transcripts, chat logs and Fathom meetings (tickets/team-chat/notes as their ingestion ships) flow into Claude's context automatically — retrieval happens in hooks, outside the model, with zero tool-call overhead. Signs you in with CIWG SSO automatically on first use (no tokens; /ciwg-login is the manual fallback). Includes explicit MCP search tools and a company-knowledge skill on the same sign-in.

plugins.name: hbis-outreach
plugins.description: HBIS outreach for Hydra clients: drafts the brief request and the follow-up chase in each client's Slack channel (email when they are not in Slack yet), checks the Hydra Production Tracker first, and logs every send to Asana. Draft-only — nothing reaches a client until the person running it sends it.

plugins.name: staging-feedback-intake
plugins.description: Client staging-site feedback for Account Managers: a twice-daily sweep of Slack and Gmail over your own Hydra projects that drafts the client reply with clarifying questions, logs the request on the tracker with the Viber tagged, and DMs the Viber a prompt-ready brief. Draft-only — nothing reaches a client until you send it.
